I. INTRODUCTION & ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS Welcome to LiveHuntShare. These Terms of Service (“Terms”) are a binding agreement between LiveHuntShare PTE. LTD. (“we”, “us”, “our”) and you (“you”, “user”). They govern your use of the LiveHuntShare app, website, and related services (“Services”) and include our Privacy Policy. By creating an account, using the Services, or clicking “I agree”, you confirm that: You are 18+ (or the legal age of majority in your country). You are not prohibited from using the Services. You have read and accepted these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the Services. We may update these Terms at any time. Changes take effect when posted. Continued use means you accept the new Terms.

II. USER RIGHTS & LICENSES 1. Access to Services You’re allowed to use LiveHuntShare’s app, website, and related features (like live streams, chats, forums, and messaging) for personal, non-commercial purposes only, provided you follow these Terms. You may not: Use the Services for anything illegal or unauthorized Hack, modify, reverse-engineer, or disrupt the Services Copy, distribute, or sell any part of the Services 2. Software & App License You’re granted a limited, non-transferable license to install and use the LiveHuntShare app/software on your personal devices. You may not: Sell, rent, or sublicense it Use or share it for commercial purposes Exploit bugs or develop harmful tools/scripts If you sell your device, log out and remove the app first. 3. Device Data We may collect technical info (e.g., device model, OS, network) to improve our services. This data won’t personally identify you and is used only for support, updates, and analytics. 4. No Other Rights Only the rights clearly listed here are granted. All other rights remain with us.

III. USER ACCOUNT AND VERIFICATION 1. Your Account A. While some features of Live Hunt Share are available without registration, access to most advanced streaming, social, and monetization features requires you to create a Live Hunt Share Account (“Account”). B. When creating an Account, you may be prompted to provide certain personal details or log in with an existing account. You agree that all information you provide will be accurate, current, and complete, and that you will promptly update it if changes occur. You must not misrepresent your age or provide false details to bypass our access requirements. You will become a Registered User once your Account is successfully created. C. You may select a unique username and display name in accordance with our Platform Rules. We reserve the right to restrict certain names for legal, safety, or community protection purposes, including prevention of impersonation, harassment, or intellectual property infringement. D. You are solely responsible for keeping your login credentials — including your account ID, username, and password — secure. You agree to immediately notify us if you suspect unauthorized use of your Account. Live Hunt Share is not responsible for any loss or damage resulting from unauthorized access to your credentials. E. If you lose your password, you may request account recovery following our verification procedures. While we will make every effort to restore access, we cannot guarantee recovery in all cases, nor can we prevent fraudulent claims by imposters who provide matching information. F. All Live Hunt Share Accounts remain the property of the Company. You are granted the right to use your Account while it remains active. Your Account must only be used by you, and may not be sold, transferred, rented, loaned, or gifted to anyone else. If we detect unauthorized use or a dispute over account ownership, we reserve the right to suspend, reclaim, or terminate the account without prior notice. Any resulting loss of communication history, data, or virtual assets will be the sole responsibility of the user. G. We may suspend, terminate, or reclaim inactive accounts or accounts that violate our Terms, community guidelines, or legal requirements. Such action may be taken with or without notice and without liability to you. 2. Real‑Name Verification A. To access certain features (including but not limited to monetization, withdrawals, agency management, or hosting privileges), you may be required to complete a Real‑Name Verification process as mandated by applicable laws or platform regulations. This may include submitting personal identification details such as your full legal name, government‑issued ID or passport number, and a verified phone number. We will handle this information as described in our Privacy Policy. B. We may also use biometric verification methods — such as facial recognition, fingerprint scanning, or other technologies — to confirm your identity. You must personally complete the biometric verification process without substitution by another individual. C. By submitting your real‑name or biometric data, you confirm that all information is truthful, accurate, and your own. False or fraudulent submissions, or attempts to bypass verification with an imposter, may result in immediate account suspension, permanent termination, and potential legal consequences. You will be responsible for any loss, damage, or liability caused by providing false information.

IV. LAWFUL AND PROPER USAGE OF THE SERVICES When using Live Hunt Share, you must follow our Platform Rules, Codes of Conduct, and Community Guidelines (“Regulations”) to ensure a safe, respectful, and lawful environment. 1. Platform Rules We may publish specific rules for certain features or activities (e.g., streaming, chatrooms, games). These rules explain how to use the feature, what is allowed, and the consequences of violations. New rules or updates will be posted online, and your continued use means you accept them. 2. Codes of Conduct You must not use the Services to: Share illegal, obscene, pornographic, violent, or harmful content. Harass, threaten, impersonate, or defame others. Violate copyrights, trademarks, privacy rights, or other legal rights. Spread malware, phishing attempts, or harmful programs. Cheat, hack, or exploit bugs for unfair advantage. Share personal information of others without consent. Abuse customer support or make false reports. 3. Community Guidelines You are encouraged to: Be respectful and friendly. Create positive, high-quality content. Engage with the community in a constructive way. You must not: Do anything illegal or promote illegal activities. Share harmful content involving minors. Upload sexually explicit, violent, hateful, or self-harm content. Threaten or blackmail anyone. Spread malicious content like viruses or spyware. Steal or alter accounts or data. Organize harassment campaigns or spam others. Create deepfake or misleading content. 4. Consequences of Violations Breaking these rules may lead to: Removal of content. Loss of in-app currency or items. Account suspension or permanent ban. Restriction of certain features. Public notice of violation. Serious or repeated violations may result in stronger penalties, and you may be legally responsible for damages.

V. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS 1. Ownership All designs, text, graphics, videos, music, software, and other materials in Live Hunt Share (“Platform Materials”) are owned by us or our licensors. You may not copy, modify, distribute, sell, or exploit Platform Materials without our written consent. User-generated content (“UGC”) remains your property, but by posting it, you grant us a worldwide, royalty-free license to use, display, distribute, and promote it in connection with the Services. We may remove UGC without notice if it violates our rules or the law. 2. Copyright Complaints If you believe your copyrighted work is used without permission: Email us at copyright@livehuntshare.com with: Your signature (physical or electronic). Description of the work. Location of the infringing material. Your contact info. Statement of good faith belief of infringement. Statement under penalty of perjury confirming your claim. If your UGC is removed and you believe it’s an error, you may send a counter‑notice with similar details.

VI. VIRTUAL CURRENCIES & VIRTUAL ITEMS We may offer Virtual Currency and Virtual Items for purchase using real money. All purchases are final — no refunds, transfers, or exchanges unless required by law or at our discretion. You may not buy, sell, or trade Virtual Currency/Items outside of Live Hunt Share. Doing so may result in confiscation, account suspension, or legal action. We may change, manage, or remove Virtual Currency/Items at any time without liability. You receive only a limited license to use Virtual Currency/Items within the Services — you do not own them.

VII. FEES, EARNINGS & PAYMENTS 1. Fees Basic use of Live Hunt Share is free. Some features, Virtual Currency, or Virtual Items may require payment. Prices are shown in the app before purchase. 2. Earnings You may earn income from activities, sponsorships, or other users. Earnings may first appear as virtual credits in your account. You can withdraw these credits only if: You are 18+ (or above your country’s legal age). You have passed real‑name verification. Earnings are from legal activities. You are not in breach of our Terms or Rules. Withdrawals may be blocked if conditions aren’t met. Compliance does not guarantee withdrawal approval. 3. Payments Payments are processed according to our posted Platform Rules. 4. Taxes You are responsible for paying all taxes, fees, or charges related to your earnings. 5. No Refunds Purchases of Virtual Currency or Virtual Items (e.g., Diamonds) are non‑refundable unless required by law.

VIII. DISCLAIMERS OF WARRANTIES No Guarantees – Live Hunt Share and its materials are provided “as is”, without any express or implied warranties, including merchantability, fitness for a purpose, title, or non‑infringement. We do not guarantee the Services will be error‑free, secure, or uninterrupted. UGC Responsibility – We are not responsible for user‑generated content (UGC) or any offensive, illegal, or harmful behavior from third parties. All risks remain with you. Account Actions – If we suspend, restrict, or terminate your account under these Terms or the law, we are not liable for any resulting loss (including data, communication, or virtual assets). No Liability in Certain Cases – We are not responsible for losses caused by: Legal or government‑ordered disclosure of personal data Sharing your password or account Hacking, viruses, telecom failures Force majeure events beyond our control IX. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY To the maximum extent allowed by law, Live Hunt Share is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, punitive, or consequential damages (including loss of profit or data). Our maximum liability is the greater of: (A) the total you paid us in the last 3 months, or (B) $100 USD. Some jurisdictions do not allow these exclusions — in such cases, we will comply with applicable law. X. TERMINATION & MODIFICATION 1. Termination / Interruption You can request account deletion anytime by contacting support. We may terminate your account or access to the Services for violations of these Terms or at our discretion. Termination may result in loss of your account, data, and any virtual items/currency without compensation. We may deny service without notice for any reason. Scheduled or unscheduled maintenance may cause temporary service interruptions. 2. Modifications We may update, modify, reprice, or discontinue the Services or parts of them at any time. If you disagree with changes, stop using the Services. Continuing to use them means you accept the changes.

XI. GOVERNING LAW & DISPUTE RESOLUTION 1. Governing Law This Agreement is governed by the laws of Singapore, regardless of your location. The UN Convention on the International Sale of Goods (1980) does not apply. 2. Dispute Resolution Any dispute will be resolved by arbitration at the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC), under SIAC rules. Seat of arbitration: Singapore. Language: English or Chinese. If arbitration is invalid/unavailable, disputes will be handled by Singapore courts. We may seek injunctions or equitable relief without posting a bond if you breach this Agreement. 3. User Disputes You are solely responsible for your interactions with other users. We may, but are not required to, assist in resolving disputes. XII. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS Your Responsibility – You must provide your own devices, internet, and pay any related costs. Notices – We may send notices via in‑app messages, email, SMS, or website announcements. Notices from you must be sent to our official contact details. Entire Agreement – This Agreement is the entire understanding between you and us. No Waiver – Our failure to enforce any right is not a waiver of that right. Severability – If part of this Agreement is invalid, the rest remains enforceable. Assignment – You cannot transfer this Agreement without our consent. We may assign freely. Headings – Section titles are for convenience only. Drafting – You agree this Agreement is not interpreted against us for having drafted it. Survival – Certain clauses (e.g., IP rights, limitation of liability) survive termination. Third‑Party Services & Ads We use third‑party services but are not responsible for their actions or your dealings with them. The Service may display ads or send you promotional messages as permitted by law. No third party gains rights from this Agreement. International Use & Export Control If this Agreement is translated, the English version prevails. Our software is subject to Singapore export laws and cannot be exported to prohibited countries or individuals. You must comply with all local laws and U.S. export restrictions if applicable.
